name: Spring to Sky Garden
hint: The garden is too high for a normal jump. Draw a Bounce pad in the marked low strip.
solution: Draw a horizontal Bounce pad from (500,612) to (610,612). Approach right with speed, spring upward, and land on the garden.

name: Amber Headwind
hint: The headwind defeats ordinary rolling. Boost along the gold work strip; stay grounded.
solution: Draw forward Boost from (350,612) to (1450,612). Its contact force overcomes the wind. Solid and Ice do not add propulsion.

name: The Wandering Orchard
hint: Ride the moving island, jump onto the small orchard, then time the last landing. The channel is a no-build zone.
solution: Wait at the bank for the island, board it, jump up to the fixed orchard before passing beneath it, then jump to the final bank.

name: Special Delivery
hint: Only the wooden parcel operates the crate-marked switch. Push it into the gold cradle; ink weights do not count.
solution: Push the parcel to x=1030. Hop over it after it settles in the cradle. The roof prevents jumping over the closed door.

name: Borrowed Time
hint: A low roof prevents jumping. You have twelve units of Fragile ink: bridge the tunnel and cross before it cracks.
solution: Draw Fragile from (480,572) to (840,572), release, and roll across before the 3.2-second collapse.

name: Slippery Freight
hint: The dispenser releases cargo when a chute is beneath it. Ice lets it slide into its switch; grippy Solid stalls it.
solution: Draw Ice from (558,342) to (1100,590). The parcel is nudged off its shelf, then slides by gravity into the cradle. Walk through the unlocked door.

name: Two Keys, One Door
hint: Route each labelled parcel into its matching cradle. Both doors must be open; the wrong parcel does not count.
solution: Draw chutes from (648,330) to (800,590) and (948,330) to (1100,590). Route N and F into their matching elevated cradles, then walk below them through both doors.

name: Elevator Picnic
hint: Board the floating elevator near its low point. Ride upward before jumping to the picnic ledge.
solution: Jump onto the elevator at x=550, wait for its high point at y=330, then jump right to the high garden. Direct bridging is forbidden over the shaft.

name: Bounce and Brake
hint: Bounce up, brake onto the small garden, then catch the travelling island. Speed alone overshoots the landing.
solution: Use a Bounce pad at the first bank. Release direction or brake on the high garden. Board the ferry when aligned and jump to the exit.

name: Garden Contraption
hint: Deliver the parcel first. Then time a spring onto the moving island and ride it toward the high exit.
solution: Push the parcel into its cradle to clear the bank door. Place Bounce on the bank beyond it, spring to the ferry, and time the last jump.

name: Snowline · Spring Garden
hint: Final station: spring from the low build strip to the high floating garden. A normal jump falls short.
solution: Coast down the icy descent onto a Solid bridge, then use gradual braking along the long uphill runout. Finish with a supported Bounce pad near the last bank and a controlled landing on the elevated island.
mastery_note: Explorer: finish. Engineer: net spent ink within budget. Master: no deaths.
